instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Ask an owner to run an action with what a form, a check or a person supplied, once", and give it action; context.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:hand-a-request-to-its-owner and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: action names the owner and what is asked: owner, action_ref (or action_refs, one request each), optionally id, a fixed input, and copy rows { key, from } or { key, value } where from reads request.<field>, answers.<field> or fields.<field> of the context.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: owner-action-request (records:read, records:write).
